How do I cancel a booking? | Send your booking reference to us on WhatsApp +66 63 704 0888 or by email, and say you want to cancel. The time we receive your message counts. Day trips are fully refundable 48 hours or more before departure and 50% refundable 24 to 48 hours before; Ang Thong tours are fully refundable 48 hours or more before and not refundable after that.
When will I get my refund? | We process refunds within 7 to 10 business days of the cancellation, back to the card you paid with and in Thai baht. Your bank may take a few more days to show the credit. Because you paid in THB, the amount in your home currency can differ slightly from the original charge because of exchange rates and card fees.
What happens if my tour is cancelled for weather? | You choose a full refund or a new date, whichever suits you. The captain and operator decide on the morning, based on sea state, wind and official marine warnings, and we tell you by WhatsApp or email as early as we can. A forecast of rain alone is not a cancellation: boats run in light rain when the sea is safe.
Can I change my date instead of cancelling? | Usually, yes, if there is space on the new date. Message us with your booking reference and preferred date as early as you can, and we confirm the change in writing. If no suitable date is available, the normal cancellation rules apply, so ask before the 48-hour full-refund deadline passes to keep every option open.
Are park and island fees refundable? | Park and island fees are not part of your booking payment, so there is nothing for us to refund. You pay them in cash on the day: 300 THB per foreign adult for Ang Thong National Park in 2026, 250 THB per adult on Koh Nang Yuan and about 50 THB on Koh Madsum where not included. If you do not travel, you do not pay them.
What counts as a no-show? | A no-show is when a guest misses the confirmed pickup and cannot be reached on the number given, arrives at the pier after the boat has left, or is refused boarding for being drunk or unsafe. No-shows are not refunded. If your driver is more than 10 minutes late, message us at once: a late pickup on our side is never a no-show.
